# Mijn TV Gids

> A comprehensive Belgian TV guide providing daily schedules, VOD releases, and entertainment news across major Flemish channels.

Mijn TV Gids is Belgium's primary television guide service, offering free access to current and upcoming TV programming across major cable channels including EEN, CANVAS, and VTM. The site provides detailed daily schedules, streaming release information, and entertainment blog coverage for Belgian viewers.

## Key Topics

- Belgian television
- EEN
- VTM
- CANVAS
- TV schedules
- Evening programming
- VOD releases
- Streaming platforms
- Flemish channels
- Free TV listings
- Cable television
- Program search
- Daily schedules
- Entertainment news
- F1 2026

## Core TV Guide

- [TVGids: tv gids en programma's vandaag of vanavond in België](https://www.mijn-tv-gids.be): Belgian TV guide homepage with daily schedules for EEN, CANVAS, VTM and more
- [Een tv programma zoeken](https://www.mijn-tv-gids.be/zoeken.html): TV program search tool for finding shows across Belgian television listings
